preconditions.description: The input S must be a string.
The length of the string S must be between 1 and 5 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(perm, str) for perm in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each permutation in the return value must be a string.
The number of permutations in the return value must be equal to the factorial of the length of the string S.
All permutations in the return value must be unique.
The permutations in the return value must be in lexicographically sorted order.
Each permutation in the return value must be a rearrangement of the characters in the input string S.
